reviewer_type: Practising power-systems engineer A; independent, rubric-constrained preliminary taxonomy review

rubric.C1_api_contract: hallucinated, missing, or wrong callable or API contract
rubric.C2_param_misuse: wrong parameter, index, table, column, or result access
rubric.C3_workflow_logic: wrong domain sequence, missing analysis, wrong network, intervention, or logic
rubric.C4_numerical_extraction: correct workflow but wrong numeric transformation or scalar extraction
rubric.C5_format_env: syntax, truncation, import, environment, timeout, or output-format execution failure
rubric.ambiguous_item_defect: evidence is insufficient or the query and reference conflict
